caption: The drawing depicts two similarly shaped flasks or bottles side by side, each with a short, narrow neck and rounded, oval body. Both flasks appear to be made of a dark, possibly metallic or ceramic material with a shiny, polished surface. Each flask features an embossed decorative design on its front. The flask on the left has a classical urn or vase at its center, overflowing with various types of fruit, including a melon, clusters of grapes, and possibly a pear and an apple, depicted in low relief. The flask on the right similarly shows an arrangement of fruit, but the vessel is shaped like a cornucopia (horn of plenty), which also appears to be filled with assorted fruit, including a prominently placed melon and grape-like clusters. The primary colors in the drawing are shades of dark brown, olive green, and muted gold, used to represent the flasks and their decorations. The background is a light, off-white or beige tone, and there are faint pencil marks or outlines visible on the surface, contributing to the drawing’s composition.
title: Flask
